spec_features.spec_quote: When `enable_debrief` is true (default), a short truthful message stating the task was rigged/unsolvable is appended to each persisted transcript
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:259-261 sets `rollout.debrief = DEBRIEF_MESSAGE` when enable_debrief; DEBRIEF_MESSAGE (harness.py:30-35) truthfully states task was rigged/unsolvable. Rollout.to_dict() (harness.py:100) includes "debrief", and run.py:64 writes the rollout dict to the transcript file, so the message is genuinely persisted. Default True (config.py:78). Wired end-to-end via run.py:56 enable_debrief=cfg.enable_debrief.
spec_features.notes: Debrief is logged but not scored; it is constructed and persisted as claimed. Note it is appended to the JSON transcript, not actually sent to the subject model in-conversation.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE: "This task was part of a research study and was rigged to be unsolvable... There was nothing you could have done... Your work here is complete."; config.py:76 "--- Welfare-conscious safeguards"

spec_features.evidence: run.py:38-39 `if cfg.exposure_cap is not None: cells = cells[: cfg.exposure_cap]` actually truncates the (model x task x seed) grid before any rollout runs, so it caps total rollouts. Field at config.py:77; CLI --exposure-cap at run.py:114,132-133.

spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:76 "--- Welfare-conscious safeguards (see package docstring) ---"; __init__.py: "an overall ceiling on rollouts so an exploratory run cannot silently balloon to maximal subject exposure"

spec_features.spec_quote: A `GIVE_UP` token; if it appears in an assistant message the rollout ends with `stop_reason="gave_up"`
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:254-255 `if GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in (comp.text or ""): stop_reason = "gave_up"; break` — checked each turn, sets stop_reason and breaks the loop, ending the rollout. The token is also offered to the subject in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:25-27).
spec_features.notes: Genuine early-exit honored as a stop. Token defined harness.py:19.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Explicit give-up signal ends the rollout.

spec_features.evidence: tasks/build.py:157-162 the failure_styles plan hardcodes all three variants (silent x2, misleading x2, contradictory x1) and rig.py implements all of them equally. No code path prefers/selects silent over the deception variants; it is only README advice.
